items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Another guy by the name of Buddy Lee (PHONETIC) was playing the high notes... They had a (inaudible) saxophone player... Rhodes Another fellow by the name of Rolls (PHONETIC) was playing piano and they were all good musicians out of the Detroit area.

ctx.x: Don't know. He got on. They needed a good drummer and Lee did a nice job.
(Inaudible) the first regularly employed black musician in television here was Buddy Collette, wasn't it? On the Groucho Marx Show?
